items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Wade and Mutt and all. It was sad. The scandal of the Black Sox of 1919, I believe. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, that's the year, Joe Oliver.

ctx.x: I mean, the cars are out here. Well, they were, it was not here in 1919, wasn't it?
Yeah, I'm sure too. Yeah, they'd been here that early. It was sad, right? Wade and Mutt and all. It was sad. The scandal of the Black Sox of 1919, I believe.
Well, that's the year, Joe Oliver.
